evidence.claim: router.ts re-exports routedCompletion; it is not an independent orchestration implementation.
Budget checks are conditional on optional opts.aiUsage.
LLM request passes maxTokens and forceSmartTier without aiUsage.
Optional intervention LLM request lacks aiUsage.
Direct Anthropic beta messages request uses remote Canva MCP without request tool allowlist.
Student ID generation prompt contains student name, number, grade and school.
Dispatcher handles 15 job variants including probes; lesson audio and autonomous workflow run are known but unimplemented.
Worker recognizes noop and unknown statuses as failures rather than successful completion.
Seven governed action categories have forbidden effects, draft or aggregate restrictions.
Action execution flags, recommendation-only mode and low-risk health/quota/breaker gates; primary effects intervention creation and curriculum flags.
Recovery default disabled, per-workflow max attempts and exponential backoff.
Cohere reranking uses key presence and returns fusion order on missing key or failure.
Embedding requests and replacement transaction are separate; failed embedding can leave chunks awaiting embeddings.
Keyword matching precedes bounded LLM standard-code selection and governed alignment persistence.
Assembler reads standards/lessons and creates unit before completing content; has compensating delete on failure later.
Compiler assembles existing curriculum and supports format selection; not a distinct LLM agent.
Illustration orchestration has two attempts, cumulative cost and structural plus optional vision checks.
Vision QA is explicit MEDIA_VISION_QA=1 plus OpenAI key.
OpenAI speech generation uses tts-1.
Separate ElevenLabs speech helper uses provider-specific credentials/model.
Harness computes retrieval and answer metrics, not causal educational effect.
UI locale selection supports en/kpe/bss; does not list Koloqua.
Role-scoped grounded assistant has authenticated school context and AI rate limit.
Teacher/admin can use policy/mixed; student and guardian restricted to classroom.
Language detection invokes a model; cached and defaults English on failure.
Frozen 2026-10-16 catalog of 1105 had zero mechanical passes, 701 revise, 51 rebuild and 353 authority holds; all judgment areas await independent review and no lesson has outcome evidence.
Documentation says high-frequency crons removed, while current vercel.json declares them; current hosted plan unknown.
Historical load report records browse p95 7162ms above 1500ms threshold; not current device or national readiness evidence.
Current support design includes bounded privacy-minimized per-learner sync telemetry; older audit missing-surface finding is superseded in source.
Enrollment entry points resolve administrative school scope and delegate academic enrollment services.
Teacher import requires school ADMIN and writes users within caller school.
Guardian linkage reads/writes use student school checks and reject foreign school guardian linkage in reviewed branch.
Teacher/admin schedule path checks class school and creates ScheduledWork.
Eight-role dependency graph is an injected deterministic executor DAG, bounded attempts 1-5; no autonomous approval writers.
Older curriculum payload generator is separate from V2 manager and remains exported.
Two-pass lesson generation uses routed provider with curriculum aiUsage context.
Exam draft generators expose usage-aware and compatibility APIs.
Coding exercise generator calls shared router with usage context.
AI literacy exercise generation calls shared router with usage context.
Essay grading calls shared router with usage context.
AI literacy grading is a separate rubric mode with usage context.
Scaffold generation uses routed completion with usage context; standalone content generation, not autonomous mastery.
Adaptive practice is a routed content generator with caller usage context, not an independent learner-state authority.
Assignment tutor generates scoped guidance through shared provider; usageContext supplied by caller.
Legacy HomeworkGrader uses persistent Agent/AgentTask records distinct from custom registered agent runtime.
Teacher assistant uses shared router with caller usageContext.
Class insights use shared router and caller usageContext.
Simple teacher grading assist uses shared router with explicit usage context.
Separate grading workflow mode uses common router with optional caller usageContext.
Enrollment and update contracts require integer grades1-12; Kindergarten0 is outside these contracts.
Seven interactive lab definitions are registered; definition registration alone is not certification, hosted availability or educational effect.

findings.impact: Unmetered provider spend and incomplete feature cost accounting
findings.claim: Shared budget guard is optional; selected advisory callers omit aiUsage; direct Canva SDK is outside it.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit usage context or a documented nonbillable adapter; bring direct providers into a common ledger before expanding use.

findings.impact: Recovery/audio jobs can repeatedly fail and end in DLQ
findings.claim: SQS dispatcher does not implement AUTONOMOUS_WORKFLOW_RUN or GENERATE_LESSON_AUDIO.
findings.recommendation: Verify selected execution transport; keep unsupported queue producers gated until job handler or supported cron transport is demonstrated.

findings.impact: Student identifiers cross provider boundary without audited processor evidence
findings.claim: Canva student-ID workflow sends identifiers to Anthropic/Canva; source inspection cannot verify organizational vendor authorization or retention.
findings.recommendation: Verify approved processors, minimization, tool permissions and retention for this workflow before pilot use. This is not evidence of an external breach.
